name: Ward
text: Cancels one whole damage instance (bump, Plume block and Hot Wax included), then breaks. Does not stop Gloam or Checkmate damage.

name: Burn
text: 1 damage at Tally, for 2 Tallies. Does not stack; reapplying resets the count to 2.

name: Dazed
text: Wickfolk: its next Strike is lost. Snuff with an intent: the intent is cancelled. Snuff without one: it declares none next Snuff Move. Boss: its last intent is cancelled.
